events.title: Coast Guard officers fire on vehicle attempting to enter Alameda base during ICE protest
events.summary: On Thursday night at approximately 10:00 p.m., Coast Guard security personnel at the Alameda base observed a U-Haul truck driving erratically and attempting to back into the entrance. After issuing multiple verbal commands to stop, the vehicle continued in reverse. Law enforcement officers discharged several rounds of live fire, striking the vehicle. Two men, including the suspected driver, were transported to hospitals with gunshot wounds. The FBI was leading the investigation. The incident occurred hours after hundreds of protesters had gathered outside the base in response to the arrival of federal immigration agents.

events.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that the U.S. military conducted its tenth strike on a boat in the Caribbean, resulting in six deaths. The administration frames these strikes as efforts to interdict drug trafficking into the United States. Hegseth simultaneously announced deployment of the aircraft carrier USS Gerald Ford and a strike group of five destroyers to waters off South America, joining an expanding military buildup in the region.

events.title: Trump administration escalates military pressure on Venezuela with bomber flights
events.summary: The U.S. Air Force flew B-1 bombers near Venezuelan airspace on Thursday as part of an escalating show of force against the Nicolás Maduro government. The flights followed similar demonstrations the previous week involving B-52 bombers and F-35 fighters. Trump stated that military action against Venezuela would target drug trafficking infrastructure on land and indicated he does not intend to seek a congressional declaration of war. Stephen Miller stated that targets in Venezuela "are terrorists and they're going to be killed." Pentagon officials described the flights as "attack demonstrations." Approximately 14% of the U.S. Navy fleet is now positioned in the Caribbean.
events.why_relevant: Escalating military demonstrations and explicit statements of intent to conduct military operations without congressional authorization represent a threat to constitutional war powers and international law.
events.basis: Trump said 'the land is going to be next' in his campaign to halt the flow of drugs into the US from Venezuela, the clearest indication yet that he's preparing to broaden strikes that have so far been limited to targets at sea.
